latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of meeting-notes-tasks-follow-up.

- Introduces a workflow to convert raw meeting transcripts or notes into clean summaries, key points, and actionable task lists.
- Output includes: meeting context, concise summary, key points, tasks with owners/status, and open questions.
- Ensures only explicit information is used—avoids inventing tasks, owners, or deadlines.
- Prioritizes concise, professional, and team-friendly formatting.
- Designed for free ClawHub edition with focus on transcript cleanup, extraction, and simple task generation.
- References included for templates and scripts to aid summarization and task extraction.

Looking for the Pro version with intelligent action items, follow-up emails, priority scoring, integrations, and follow-up tracking? Get it here: https://galipaweb.gumroad.com/l/meeting-notes-tasks-follow-up-pro
